# Quillbrook Drafting - plans mirror

The drawing office's plans directory is the source of truth and is mirrored to a site laptop.
The options the drawing office uses are carded in transfer/mirror-option-cards.tsv.

turns.prompt: Quillbrook Drafting keeps the drawing office's plans directory as the source of truth and mirrors it to a site laptop.
